name: Methoxpropamine
summary: Methoxpropamine (MXPr, 2-Oxo-3'-methoxy-PCPr) is a dissociative anesthetic drug of the arylcyclohexylamine class and NMDA receptor antagonist that is closely related to substances such as methoxetamine and PCPr. It has been sold online as a designer drug, first being identified in Denmark in October 2019, and is illegal in Finland.

pharmacology.text: Methoxpropamine (MXPr, 2-Oxo-3'-methoxy-PCPr) is a dissociative anesthetic drug of the arylcyclohexylamine class and NMDA receptor antagonist that is closely related to substances such as methoxetamine and PCPr.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it specifically. Related dissociatives such as methoxetamine can cause confusion, poor coordination, raised blood pressure and heart rate and dangerous accidents, and regular use of ketamine-like drugs can damage the bladder.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它本身所知甚少。甲氧麻醉胺等相關解離劑可能引起混亂、協調變差、血壓與心跳上升，以及危險的意外，經常使用類氯胺酮藥物也可能損傷膀胱。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它本身所知甚少。甲氧麻醉胺等相关解离剂可能引起混乱、协调制差、血压与心跳上升，以及危险的意外，经常使用类氯胺酮药物也可能损伤膀胱。

fact.en: MXPr is the propyl cousin of methoxetamine: MXE carries an ethyl group on its nitrogen, while MXPr carries a propyl group.
fact.zh: MXPr 是甲氧麻醉胺的丙基表親：MXE 的氮原子上接乙基，MXPr 接的則是丙基。
fact.zhHans: MXPr 是甲氧麻醉胺的丙基表亲：MXE 的氮原子上接乙基，MXPr 接的则是丙基。
